ci.prTitle: Bump GitHub Actions to Node 24 runtime versions

metadata.gitDiff:
diff --git a/.github/workflows/playwright.yml b/.github/workflows/playwright.yml
index afa303f..8b42429 100644
--- a/.github/workflows/playwright.yml
+++ b/.github/workflows/playwright.yml
@@ -21,8 +21,8 @@ jobs:
       # Kept as a workflow-level env var so the SUT can be repointed in one place.
       BASE_URL: https://demoqa.com
     steps:
-      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
-      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
+      - uses: actions/setup-node@v5
         with:
           node-version: lts/*
           cache: npm
@@ -38,7 +38,7 @@ jobs:
       # Uploaded on failure too — the report is most useful precisely when the
       # run is red. This is how PR runs get their report, since PRs don't publish.
       - name: Upload HTML report
-        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
+        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v5
         if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
         with:
           name: playwright-report-${{ github.run_number }}
@@ -69,14 +69,14 @@ jobs:
       # The publish script lives on the source branch, not on gh-pages, so it is
       # checked out separately into its own directory.
       - name: Checkout scripts from source branch
-        uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        uses: actions/checkout@v5
         with:
           path: source
           sparse-checkout: scripts
           sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false
 
       - name: Checkout gh-pages
-        uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        uses: actions/checkout@v5
         with:
           ref: gh-pages
           path: pages
@@ -84,7 +84,7 @@ jobs:
       # Downloaded straight into the archive slot for this run; the root copy
       # below is taken from there.
       - name: Download report

+        uses: actions/download-artifact@v5

+        uses: actions/github-script@v8
